description: Defines the CleanCacheWorker class responsible for scheduled cache cleanup tasks in the F-Droid app, including deleting expired APKs, stray index files, old installer files, and cache icons.

classes.name: CleanCacheWorker
classes.description: A Worker subclass that performs cache cleanup tasks periodically or on demand.

classes.name: Impl21
classes.description: Helper class for Android API level 21+ to delete files based on last access time.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules periodic cache cleanup work based on user preferences.

methods.name: force
methods.description: Enqueues an immediate cache cleanup work request.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs cache cleanup tasks when the worker runs.

methods.name: deleteExpiredApksFromCache
methods.description: Deletes APK files in cache older than the user-defined keep time.

methods.name: deleteOldInstallerFiles
methods.description: Deletes old installer files, avoiding files in use or recently created.

methods.name: deleteStrayIndexFiles
methods.description: Removes outdated index and download files from cache directory.

methods.name: deleteOldIcons
methods.description: Deletes cached icons not accessed in over a year.

methods.name: clearOldFiles
methods.description: Recursively deletes files or directories older than a specified age.

methods.name: deleteFileAndLog
methods.description: Deletes a file and logs the action.

methods.name: deleteIfOld
methods.description: Deletes a file if it is older than a specified threshold, based on last access or modification time.
